tagline: Ferrania取景器相机，1959 年发布
description: Ferrania于1959年推出的取景器相机。配备Acromatico Ferrania 58mm f/7.7。快门速度1/50th, 1/100th and Bulb。使用127 film - 3x4cm image size。5 feet to infinity。

specs.闪光灯: Yes, via a PC socket with an accessory shoe mounted flash
specs.英文简介: The Ibis 34 is cast aluminium viewfinder camera taking 3x4cm pictures on 127 film, made in Italy by Ferrania, c.1959.
